records.caller_and_user_entry: jackin eject, jackin exile, purge and restore flows
records.current_owner: Jackin chooses stop/purge. Apple provider stop owns the active eject operation. An Apple remove/rm implementation exists but no production caller was found.
records.action_outcome: Eject calls stop, retaining object; exile enumerates Apple instances by local manifests then stops them; purge guard requires exact Apple container absence. Apple remove/remove_with calls client.remove_container but has no production caller. Runtime removal and Jackin state purge are distinct; the active Apple lifecycle does not establish runtime-object deletion.
records.new_owner: OpenShell owns sandbox stop/delete; Jackin owns retention/purge authorization and retained state.
records.exact_mechanism: Map Jackin lifecycle intents to OpenShell stop/delete; prove idempotency, explicit resource inventory, recovery, retained data, and safe repeated cleanup.
records.code_change_expected: Replace provider lifecycle routing; maintain user-facing lifecycle meanings and separation between runtime delete and retained-state purge.
records.evidence_and_status: Active source dispatch for stop/eject/exile/purge guard, no Apple runtime execution. Apple removal convenience path is implemented without a production caller.
records.release_test: OpenShell lifecycle tests elsewhere do not prove this integrated contract. No production caller for Apple remove/rm was found.

records.symbol_or_feature: Active Docker profile preparation vs uncalled full-inspection/grant-readback foundations
records.caller_and_user_entry: Security profile and effective grants selected during jackin load
records.current_owner: Jackin owns requested profiles. Docker launch actively applies profile settings and probes cgroup/AppArmor facts. Apple provider receives an AppleContainerSpec.
records.action_outcome: Apple early dispatch bypasses Docker runtime profile setup. Apple spec has empty caps_add and no CPU/memory/pids/fd fields. No Apple VM sizing/create/delete request is present. inspect_full_container_by_id has trait/default and adapter implementation but no production call; compare_grant_vs_actual has no production call; launch passes workflow_grant: None. Docker profile application is separate from the inactive actual-grant readback foundation.
records.new_owner: Jackin retains active profile intent; OpenShell driver/policy and any separate engine enforce active grants/budgets.
records.exact_mechanism: Translate actively used grants and verify allowed and denied operations. Do not require full-inspection readback or live-write barrier solely from uncalled foundation; require it only if an active user contract establishes it. Do not infer VM sizing from Docker flags.
records.code_change_expected: Translate active supported profile controls into OpenShell configuration; no requirement to port uncalled Docker readback foundation absent product caller.
records.evidence_and_status: Apple profile enforcement NOT PROVEN. Docker grant readback is NOT A PRODUCTION CALLER. No Apple limits requested in code. Source-only.
records.release_test: No Apple resource-limit/profile runtime test in this audit; target-specific OpenShell controls require separate execution proof.

Capsule uses Darwin reaper setup only under cfg(target_os = "macos"); the Apple Container guest is Linux, so that Capsule branch does not apply. Host Jackin macOS uses a separate jackin-process reaper.

records.code_change_expected: Replace provider startup wiring, preserve only required supervisor and session behavior.
records.evidence_and_status: Active source call path; no runtime proof that guest agent is root or that force-stop cleanup works.
records.release_test: Rooted Capsule session path and actual target must be exercised elsewhere.
